faq: Do I need to supply a new design?
No. We can design and build in one go, starting from your logo and brand colors. If you already have a Figma design, send it and we build that instead, which often keeps the price at the lower end.
Will the redesign hurt my search rankings?

We aim to protect them. Page addresses stay the same unless there is a reason to change them, titles and headings are kept, and any moved page gets a 301 redirect. We cannot promise rankings, but we avoid the common mistakes.
Do you redesign the live site directly?
We work on a copy of the project, show you a preview and publish only after your approval. Your live site keeps running as normal while we build.
Is new copy and photography included?
We reuse your existing text and images and reshape them to fit the new layout. If you want fresh copy or photos, send them in and we place them, or we flag the gaps in the handover.
